## Calculated Values {#sec-calculated}

Parameters derived from mathematical formulas and economic models.

### Drug Cost Increase: Pre-1962 to Current: 105x {#sec-drug_cost_increase_pre1962_to_current_multiplier}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Drug development cost increase from pre-1962 to current

**Inputs**:

- [Pharma Drug Development Cost (Current System)](#sec-pharma_drug_development_cost_current) 📊: $2.6B (95% CI: $1.5B - $4B)
- [Pre-1962 Drug Development Cost (2024 Dollars)](#sec-pre_1962_drug_development_cost_2024_usd) 📊: $24.7M (95% CI: $19.5M - $30M)

$$
\begin{gathered}
k_{cost,pre62} \\
= \frac{Cost_{dev,curr}}{Cost_{pre62,24}} \\
= \frac{\$2.6B}{\$24.7M} \\
= 105
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [@pre-1962-drug-costs-baily-1972]

*✓ High confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

### RECOVERY Trial Cost Reduction Factor: 82x {#sec-recovery_trial_cost_reduction_factor}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Cost reduction factor demonstrated by RECOVERY trial (traditional Phase 3 cost / RECOVERY cost per patient)

**Inputs**:

- [Phase 3 Cost per Patient](#sec-traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient) 📊: $41K (95% CI: $20K - $120K)
- [Recovery Trial Cost per Patient](#sec-recovery_trial_cost_per_patient) 📊: $500 (95% CI: $400 - $2.5K)

$$
\begin{gathered}
k_{RECOVERY} \\
= \frac{Cost_{P3,pt}}{Cost_{RECOVERY,pt}} \\
= \frac{\$41K}{\$500} \\
= 82
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [@recovery-trial-82x-cost-reduction]

*✓ High confidence*

#### Sensitivity Analysis

## External Data Sources {#sec-external}

Parameters sourced from peer-reviewed publications, institutional databases, and authoritative reports.

### CPI Multiplier: 1980 to 2024: 3.8:1 {#sec-cpi_multiplier_1980_to_2024}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

CPI inflation multiplier from 1980 to 2024 (280.48% cumulative inflation)

**Source**: [@bls-cpi-inflation-calculator]

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [3.75:1, 3.85:1] • Distribution: Normal

**What this means**: We're quite confident in this estimate. The true value likely falls between 3.75:1 and 3.85:1 (±1%). This represents a narrow range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

*The normal distribution means values cluster around the center with equal chances of being higher or lower.*

#### Input Distribution

{{< include ../figures/distribution-cpi_multiplier_1980_to_2024.qmd >}}

*✓ High confidence*

:::

### Average Annual New Drug Approvals Globally: 50 drugs/year {#sec-current_drug_approvals_per_year}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Average annual new drug approvals globally

**Source**: [@global-new-drug-approvals-50-annually]

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [45 drugs/year, 60 drugs/year] • Distribution: Lognormal

**What this means**: This estimate has moderate uncertainty. The true value likely falls between 45 drugs/year and 60 drugs/year (±15%). This represents a reasonable range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

*The lognormal distribution means values can't go negative and have a longer tail toward higher values (common for costs and populations).*

#### Input Distribution

{{< include ../figures/distribution-current_drug_approvals_per_year.qmd >}}

*✓ High confidence*

:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Conservative lazy loading: only load images actually in viewport
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  let imageObserver = null;
  let loadTimeout = null;
  
  function enableLazyLoading() {
    const images = document.querySelectorAll('img');
    
    // Use Intersection Observer with conservative threshold
    // rootMargin: '50px' means only load images within 50px of viewport
    // This prevents loading images passed through during hash navigation
    imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0) {
          const img = entry.target;
          // Only load if image is actually visible (not just passed through)
          if (img.dataset.src) {
            img.src = img.dataset.src;
            img.removeAttribute('data-src');
          } else if (!img.hasAttribute('loading')) {
            // For images without data-src, use native lazy loading
            img.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
          }
          observer.unobserve(img);
        }
      });
    }, {
      rootMargin: '50px',  // Only load images within 50px of viewport
      threshold: 0.01      // Trigger when at least 1% visible
    });
    
    images.forEach(img => {
      imageObserver.observe(img);
    });
  }
  
  // Handle hash navigation (clicking links to sections)
  // Delay loading to avoid loading images passed through during jump
  function handleHashNavigation() {
    if (loadTimeout) clearTimeout(loadTimeout);
    // Wait 300ms after navigation to let scroll settle
    // Images will load naturally via Intersection Observer when visible
    loadTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      // Scroll has settled, Intersection Observer will handle visible images
      // No action needed - observer is already watching
    }, 300);
  }
  
  // Initialize on page load
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', enableLazyLoading);
  } else {
    enableLazyLoading();
  }
  
  // Handle hash changes (clicking anchor links)
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHashNavigation);
  
  // Also handle initial hash if page loads with one
  if (window.location.hash) {
    setTimeout(handleHashNavigation, 100);
  }
})();
</script>
```
